Build all jnanalytics tables in BigQuery

Source: R/build.R
jn_build.Rd

Uploads the reference tables, then builds the article tables and the aggregates in dependency order: articles, article_first_authors, journal_year, journal_year_country, journal_year_license, journal_year_country_license, article_agreements, agreement_journal_year, agreement_articles and agreement_institution_year.

Usage

jn_build(
  config = jn_bq_config(),
  year_min = 2016L,
  year_max = as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")),
  tables = jn_build_order(),
  upload = TRUE,
  max_gb = 200
)

Arguments

config

See jn_bq_config().

year_min, year_max

Publication years covered.

tables

Tables to build, in this order. Defaults to all.

upload

If TRUE, upload the reference tables first.

max_gb

Stop without running if the query would scan more than this.

Value

The built BigQuery tables, invisibly.
